heading.en: The righteous Lamanites preach to the wicked Nephites—Both peoples prosper during an era of peace and plenty—Lucifer, the author of sin, stirs up the hearts of the wicked and the Gadianton robbers in murder and wickedness—The robbers take over the Nephite government. About 29–23 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua tala'i atu sa Lamanā amiotonu i sa Nifaē amioleaga—Ua manuia nuu uma e lua i se vaitaimi o le filemu ma le mau—Ua faaoso e Lusifelo, le pogai o le agasala, loto o tagata amioleaga ma le au faomea a Katianetona i le fasioti tagata ma le amioleaga—Ua pulea e le au faomea le malo o sa Nifaē. E tusa 29–23 T.L.M.
